capabilities: Expand natural language dates inline via autosuggestion while typing
Parse selected text into dates, times, links, or plain text with commands
Open daily notes for natural language dates
Open daily notes through the obsidian://nldates URI
Pick dates from a date picker menu
extras: Not yet approved for the Obsidian community plugin directory (pending since Feb 6, 2025), so it must be installed manually from release zips.
intentEvidence: I decided I'd start maintaining it and introduce features that I always wanted
motivation: The original plugin had been abandoned for over two years, so the author revived it to add features they had always wanted and that were frequently requested.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to type dates in natural language and convert them into formatted timestamps or links to daily notes.
summary: Natural language date parser that inserts date and time links, autocompletes dates inline, and opens daily notes via commands or an Obsidian URI.
